description: Change Instagram artist posts from single image to 3-slide carousel: slide 1 is the artist profile picture, slides 2 and 3 are 30-second track preview videos with animated waveform overlay and audio.

steps.task: Create video.rs module: generate 30-second MP4 track preview from artist image + peaks JSON + audio

sub_plan.description: Break video generation into atomic sub-tasks

steps.task: Add video.rs module declaration in main.rs and create skeleton file with public function signature: generate_track_preview_video(state, artist_image_key, track_key, peaks_key, duration_secs) -> Result<Vec<u8>>
Implement peaks JSON parsing: download peaks from R2, deserialize JSON array of f64 values, normalize to 0.0-1.0 range

knowledge.notes: Peaks are stored client-side as JSON arrays, uploaded via multipart text fields. Key derived by derive_peaks_key() in handlers/api.rs

steps.task: Implement waveform PNG rendering using imageproc + image crates: render orange vertical bars on transparent 1080x200 PNG from normalized peaks data, matching the existing SoundCloud-style waveform look

decisions: Use imageproc (already in Cargo.toml) to render static waveform PNG rather than FFmpeg filters for better visual control
knowledge.notes: image crate has png+jpeg features enabled. Waveform style: orange bars (#f09433) on transparent background, bottom-aligned, similar to SoundCloud/WaveSurfer

steps.task: Implement FFmpeg video composition: combine artist image (looped 30s) + track audio (first 30s) + waveform PNG overlay + animated cursor line (white vertical bar moving left-to-right). Output 1080x1080 H.264+AAC MP4 at 30fps

decisions: Use FFmpeg CLI via tokio::process::Command (same pattern as audio.rs convert_to_mp3)
Render waveform as static PNG overlay positioned at bottom of frame
Animate cursor using FFmpeg drawbox filter with enable='between(t,X,Y)' expressions
knowledge.notes: FFmpeg command: -loop 1 -i image.jpg -i track.mp3 -i waveform.png -t 30 -filter_complex '[0]scale=1080:1080[bg];[bg][2]overlay=0:880[v];[v]drawbox=x=...:y=880:w=2:h=200:color=white:enable=...' -c:v libx264 -c:a aac -shortest output.mp4

steps.task: Wire it all together: download artist image + track MP3 + peaks JSON from R2 to temp dir, call rendering pipeline, return MP4 bytes, clean up temp files

knowledge.notes: Use storage::get_presigned_url or direct S3 GetObject to download files. Use tempfile crate or tokio::fs with temp dir for intermediate files.

decisions: Use FFmpeg CLI for video generation (already installed, used by audio.rs)
Use imageproc for waveform rendering (already in Cargo.toml)
No new Rust crate dependencies needed for video generation

steps.task: Extend InstagramClient in instagram.rs with carousel posting support (multi-slide album posts with images and videos)

sub_plan.description: Add Instagram Graph API carousel methods

steps.task: Add create_carousel_image_item(image_url) method: POST to /{account_id}/media with image_url + is_carousel_item=true, returns container ID
Add create_carousel_video_item(video_url) method: POST to /{account_id}/media with media_type=VIDEO, video_url, is_carousel_item=true, returns container ID
Add create_carousel_container(children_ids, caption) method: POST to /{account_id}/media with media_type=CAROUSEL, children={id1,id2,...}, caption

Add post_carousel(image_url, video_urls, caption) orchestrator: create all item containers, poll each until FINISHED, create carousel container, poll, publish. Increase poll timeout to 120s for video processing

decisions: Increase poll timeout from 60s to 120s for video containers
Poll all children in parallel using tokio::join!

steps.task: Update post_artist_to_instagram() to generate 2 track preview videos, upload to R2, and post as 3-slide carousel instead of single image

sub_plan.description: Wire video generation and carousel posting into the existing artist Instagram flow

steps.task: Add helper functions to upload temporary video files to R2 (artists/{id}/instagram-preview-track1.mp4) and delete them after posting

knowledge.notes: Use existing storage::upload_file pattern. Store under artists/{id}/ namespace. Clean up after successful Instagram post.

steps.task: Rewrite post_artist_to_instagram(): generate 2 preview videos via video::generate_track_preview_video(), upload to R2, get presigned URLs for image + 2 videos, call client.post_carousel(), clean up temp videos from R2

decisions: Fall back to single-image post if artist has no peaks data or tracks
Clean up temp R2 files in a finally block even if posting fails

steps.task: Compile and test: verify cargo check passes, test video generation with a real artist's data, verify Instagram carousel post flow end-to-end
